event_data.context: Filesystem PRs #4 and #5 merged. SQLite PR #6 revision 6950db0 verifies the exact number of rows changed for each event write and checkpoint save. The new rollback test covers trigger-skipped writes with count_changes enabled and disabled. All 38 local tests pass in each backend mode. CI run 45508303132 and renewed review are pending. The command snapshot prototype passes 45 local tests against this revision; PostgreSQL remains in progress.
event_data.summary: Port and verify the durable storage and command state capabilities of EventCore 2.1.0 on Erlang/OTP.
event_data.title: Durable storage and command state
